Title: Runaway Dream (Top Deck)
Description:
A small buff for the Dream mechanic.

At the start of your turn (after the draw step), if you have any cards with the Dream keyword, you can now choose up to 1 Dream card to place on top of your deck. This action does not remove the Dream keyword from other cards; only the card that is placed.

This only happens if you don't reshuffle at the start of your turn (in which case the vanilla game will let you retrieve up to 1 Dream card, as per usual).
Brief: A small buff for the Dream mechanic.
